title: Rice Krispies Treats
description:
Few things are as easy to make as Rice Krispies Treats. But, from the time the girls were little through their years at college, these were among their very favorite treats!
The basic recipe is usually included on both the Rice Krispies cereal box and the marshmallow bag, but we include it in our cookbook because it truly is a family favorite. Adding sprinkles is our own special touch that adds some color and festiveness to the bars.
START TO FINISH: 1 HOUR
Rice Krispies Treats
Place butter (cut into 4-6 pieces) in a large microwavable bowl.
Microwave on high for 45 seconds or until melted.
Add marshmallows to the melted butter; toss to coat thoroughly.
Microwave marshmallow mixture for 45 seconds; stir and microwave for an additional 45 seconds or until the mixture is smooth and melted.
Add cereal immediately; mix until well coated.
directions: Press marshmallow/cereal mixture into a buttered 9”x13” pan. Use a piece of wax paper or the back of a large spoon to spread the mixture evenly. (It spreads a little easier if you allow the mixture to cool a bit.)
For extra fun, add sprinkles over the top of the mixture. Gently press the sprinkles down using the back of a large spoon.
Allow mixture to fully cool (about 60 minutes) before cutting.
